title: Learn about the Apple Projected Media Profile
description: Dive into the Apple Projected Media Profile (APMP) and see how APMP enables 180º/360º and Wide FoV projections in QuickTime and MP4 files using Video Extended Usage signaling. We’ll provide guidance on using OS-provided frameworks and tools to convert, read/write, edit, and encode media containing APMP. And we’ll review Apple Positional Audio Codec’s (APAC) capabilities for creating and delivering spatial audio content for the most immersive experiences.
